entries.name: conflict-highlighting-first
entries.summary: First implementation of conflict highlighting for offline edits.
entries.readWhen: Before modifying conflict visualization or when working on offline edit display

touches.note: added visualization of conflicts in the sync system

entries.name: sync-worker-separate-thread
entries.summary: Moved the sync worker to its own thread to improve application responsiveness.
entries.readWhen: Before modifying the sync worker or when investigating thread safety issues

touches.note: moved sync worker to separate thread

entries.name: offline-queue
entries.summary: Edits made offline wait in a queue and replay in order when the device reconnects.
entries.readWhen: Before changing offline edit storage or replay logic, or when edits are skipped or applied out of order

touches.note: implements the invariant that edits replay in order

entries.name: batched-uploads
entries.summary: Grouped queued edits into batches of 50 for upload to stay under server rate limits.
entries.readWhen: Before changing the batch size or upload strategy, or when uploads are throttled or rejected
